detailed_description: The Bubble Chart Generator creates a 2D ECharts scatter chart where each point has an X value, Y value, and bubble size. You can edit sample series directly in the browser, add or remove series and points, set optional point names, adjust the chart title and axis names, choose a color theme, toggle the legend, and preview the chart immediately. Finished charts can be downloaded as PNG or SVG images.
usage_steps: Edit the sample series name and point rows, including point name, X value, Y value, and size.
Use Add Series or Add Point when you need more data entries.
Adjust the chart title, axis names, color theme, and legend setting in the chart settings panel.
Check the live chart preview and download the result as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Example 1: Compare products by plotting price on the X-axis, rating on the Y-axis, and sales volume as bubble size.
Example 2: Sketch a portfolio view where each point represents an asset with risk, return, and position size.
Example 3: Create a classroom example that shows how changing bubble size affects the visual weight of each data point.
Example 4: Export a simple bubble chart as SVG for use in a report or slide deck.
